stations.title: Noor
stations.say: Set aside 3 jars of honey for Ben.

stations.title: Pip
stations.text: Sometimes sends a bad tool call.
stations.note: A wrong name, or a number as text.

stations.title: Your code
stations.gap: A bad call ends the run

captions: Noor asks Pip to set aside three jars of honey for Ben's order.
Pip sends a tool call that is slightly wrong, and the whole run crashes.
You write the part that checks each call, in three tasks.
Now a bad call comes back as a result Pip can read, and it tries again.
Same request, no stack trace. The honey is set aside.
